name: GATE Engineering Mathematics atomic sub-topic catalogue
notes: Demand-side layer: one row per atomic sub-topic a student actually searches for.
concept_ids maps each atom onto the mastery spine in data/curriculum/gate-ma.yml (concepts: section). Linear Algebra is fully mapped; other modules are mapped in follow-up phases.

Per-learner runtime fields from the research workbook (mastery_state, attempt_count, ...) are deliberately NOT committed here — learner state lives in the database, never in content data. See surveillance invariants.

question_inventory semantics: mcq_target + msq_target + nat_target == target_total. pyq_variant_target is an OVERLAY — the number of those items that should be authored as variants of real PYQs — not a fourth additive bucket.

The intent distribution in this catalogue is structured research derived from query templates, NOT measured demand. Treat it as a routing hypothesis to be validated against real behavior; see the design doc.
competitor_coverage_level and source_scope are reference-only research fields; the workbook itself marks competitor data "verify before publication".
